doctrine: The propagation ORDER and MEMBERSHIP decide whether the whole tree is fresh, and they were hand-maintained JS arrays inside the runner itself — the same defect class as the three hand-typed repository lists that had already drifted. This registry is now the source of truth; build-derived-all is the ENGINE that reads it. Adding a generator means adding a row.

phases.purpose: Source-of-truth generators that write Astro SOURCE fragments and standalone manifests. Run first because later phases read what they produce.

propagators.rationale: §70 coverage dashboard — coverage-report.generated.json (+ public mirror), coverage.html, and every per-framework public/site/compliance/<fw>.html. FIRST in P1 because it writes pages the P2 page-registry must scan, and it produces the coverage-report that coverage-attestation (end of P3) consumes. Independent of the page chain, so it runs first and cheaply.
